title: Two segwit v0 inputs with no previous transactions

wallet.mnemonic: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about

attack: Nothing is false here, but nothing proves the amounts either. BIP-143 commits each signature to its own input's amount only, so a coordinator can understate a different input in each of two signing rounds and combine one valid signature from each: the fee actually paid is larger than either screen showed.
rule: Ask for the previous transactions, or tell the user the input amounts are unverified.
